summary.text: VÅR BISTRO AS is a private limited company registered in Kongsberg, founded 2016-02-04. VÅR BISTRO AS driver catering, kafé og restaurantdrift, og investerer også i andre beslektede virksomheter. It was previously named MARLENES BISTRO AS until 2025-09-04. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. The register shows 11 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 8 556 382 NOK and the annual result was 1 002 189 NOK; operating income was down from 9 999 087 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 011 519 NOK in 2024 to 1 002 189 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 1 066 211 NOK in 2024 to 743 000 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is varbistro.no. The registered employee count went from 9 on 2026-03-12 to 11 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
